points.text: M1: d orbitals split into two levels / lower and upper orbitals
M2: electron(s) promoted / excited to a higher d-orbital
M4: observed colour is complement of light absorbed
(addition of $\text{NH}_3$) increases $[\text{OH}^{-}]$ (due to ionisation of $\text{NH}_3$ in water) and shifts equilibrium 1 to the right (forming $\text{Ni(OH)}_2$)

(a large excess of $\text{NH}_3$) shifts eqm 2 to the right (forming $[\text{Ni(NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$) AND the $[\text{Ni}^{2+}]/[[\text{Ni(H}_2\text{O)}_6]^{2+}]$ decreases and eqm 1 shifts to the left (causing the ppt to dissolve)
M1: two correct structures cis & trans for $[\text{NiBr}_2(\text{CN})_2]^{2-}$
M2: type of stereoisomerism: cis-trans / geometric
